q: What does "automation" mean in real terms?
a: Connecting your forms, inbox, calendar and spreadsheets so enquiries get answered, routed or logged automatically. Not bolting a gimmick chatbot onto your homepage.

q: Who owns the website and accounts?

q: How long does a website take?
a: Sites up to 5 pages go live within 7 days, guaranteed, or you get £100 off the final invoice. The 7 days start once the quote is accepted and your copy, photos and logins are in, and pause while a design is waiting on your feedback. Bigger sites and shops get a fixed date in the quote.
